title: Tiny, cute alarm clock
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- shadow/glow bed -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='34' ry='5' fill='#2a1a3a'/>
  <!-- left foot -->
  <rect x='26' y='78' width='8' height='9' rx='3' fill='#7fd4ff'/>
  <!-- right foot -->
  <rect x='66' y='78' width='8' height='9' rx='3' fill='#7fd4ff'/>
  <!-- bells -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='26' r='11' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='26' r='7' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='26' r='11' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='26' r='7' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
  <!-- hammer between bells -->
  <rect x='45' y='14' width='10' height='4' rx='2' fill='#9be89b'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='16' r='3' fill='#c9f7c9'/>
  <!-- little legs to bells -->
  <rect x='30' y='34' width='5' height='10' rx='2.5' fill='#66c2f0'/>
  <rect x='65' y='34' width='5' height='10' rx='2.5' fill='#66c2f0'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='32' fill='#ff6b8a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='32' fill='none' stroke='#ff9fb2' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- inner face plate -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='24' fill='#fff6f0'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='24' fill='none' stroke='#ffd9e2' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- clock feet on face -->
  <!-- tick marks -->
  <rect x='49' y='33' width='2' height='4' rx='1' fill='#ffa5b8'/>
  <rect x='49' y='71' width='2' height='4' rx='1' fill='#ffa5b8'/>
  <rect x='28' y='53' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ffa5b8'/>
  <rect x='68' y='53' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ffa5b8'/>
  <!-- hands -->
  <rect x='49' y='40' width='2' height='15' rx='1' fill='#5a3a6a'/>
  <rect x='50' y='53' width='13' height='2' rx='1' fill='#5a3a6a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='3' fill='#5a3a6a'/>
  <!-- cute eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='48' r='3' fill='#3c2a4d'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='48' r='3' fill='#3c2a4d'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='47' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='47' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 61 Q50 66 55 61' fill='none' stroke='#5a3a6a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='58' r='3' fill='#ffb3c6'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='58' r='3' fill='#ffb3c6'/>
</svg>
